scheduler.gateStore: voice control = waveform & 254; restRemaining=(restRemaining+1)&255 before its unconditional decrement
scheduler.disable: increment enableFlag modulo256; do not advance stream pointer; skip subsequent voice processing

notes.positive: 1..127; apply transpose modulo256; sound setup resolves current/target pitch
notes.zero: rest; reload restRemaining only, with no pitch/onset setup or immediate SID store
notes.duration: Persistent nonzero override supplies the duration and omits the stream duration byte; zero override consumes the following byte
notes.durationZero: Zero byte lasts 256 subsequent calls by decrement-before-zero scheduling
notes.spacing: A note loaded at call N with nonzero duration D advances again at N+D

control.commandTiming: Execute setters and navigation in stream order in the same call, ending at a note/rest/disable
control.repeat: One saved pointer/counter per voice; start replaces them; end decrements modulo256, jumping while nonzero
control.scoreCall: Save address+3, increment depth before reading destination operands; return pops the saved address
control.sidStoreList: One or more nonnegative offset/value pairs at $D400+offset, terminated by a negative offset byte; zero pairs are outside executed contract
control.pulseZeroDefault: A zero pulse default loads the separate pulseFallback into live pulseWord; all observed fallback words are zero and $94 is unexecuted

soundBoundary.commandInput: Typed operand fields plus current named state; command-setters.json.gz retains assignments and immediate SID stores
soundBoundary.ownership: Score owns navigation/countdown/gate/rest and setters. Sound owns continuing body stages and positive-note setup, retaining state between notes.
soundBoundary.noteSetupEvidence: Sound probe owns full onset/reset arithmetic; this score proof only independently schedules its input events
